summary: Map edges examined and rejected in causal maps batch 1. (1) STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE -> STMT-CAUSE-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES: q.4 a.2 constrains only causes of a thing's being; the unrestricted principle would need every cause of a perfection to be a cause of being, which the heater refutes. Only the scoped STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES was derived. (2) STMT-ESSE-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION -> STMT-RECEIVED-PERFECTION-IS-LIMITED-BY-RECIPIENT: the generalization from esse to every perfection does not follow from the instance, and the source premise has the converse direction (limited -> received); both generalized directions are kept as open supported statements instead. (3) STMT-AQUINAS-ST-I-Q44-A1-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-COUNTERFACTUAL-DEPENDENCE -> STMT-EFFECT-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING-ON-EFFICIENT-CAUSE: the q.44 statement has no Lean declaration, so no derivation can bind it; recorded as a supports relation. Not attempted: a strengthens registration from STMT-CAUSE-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES to its scoped version (it would be a single application of one hypothesis). Rejection records that the leads were examined; it neither refutes nor establishes any target.
